overall_notes: This paper focuses on data poisoning attacks on NLP models across three tasks: sentiment analysis, language modeling/dialogue generation, and machine translation. While sentiment analysis is classification, the paper also evaluates NLG tasks (dialogue generation and MT). Human evaluation was conducted for LM outputs (sentiment judgment) and MT outputs (exact phrase matching), but no automatic metrics or LLM-as-judge methods were used. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and consolidation.
